issues.description: React hydration error: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' firing repeatedly, causing entire root to switch to client rendering. This indicates dynamic/random content (likely particle positions or counts) is being rendered during SSR and differs from client render.
issues.element: Gold particle animation canvas or any component using Math.random() / Date.now() at render time
issues.root_cause: The particle animation component likely initializes particle positions using Math.random() at module/render level (outside useEffect), causing SSR-rendered HTML to have different values than the client hydration pass. This triggers the hydration mismatch cascade.

issues.description: Gold particle animation is not visibly animating on the canvas — the background appears as a flat dark navy color with no visible particle effects.
issues.root_cause: Likely the canvas/particle component is either not mounted (due to hydration error killing client render), or the animation uses window/requestAnimationFrame without being wrapped in useEffect with a client-only guard, causing it to silently fail.

issues.description: Failed to fetch RSC payload for /design/step-7d — a non-existent route was navigated to, resulting in a 404 fallback. Not blocking current screen but indicates a broken link somewhere in the app.
issues.root_cause: Some component contains a hardcoded or incorrectly constructed href pointing to '/design/step-7d' which does not exist as a page route.

fixes.reason: Replace Math.random() with deterministic values so SSR and client produce identical HTML, eliminating the hydration mismatch. The golden-ratio-derived offsets distribute particles pseudo-randomly but consistently.

Add a mounted guard so the canvas animation only initializes on the client after hydration is complete, preventing any window/requestAnimationFrame access during SSR and ensuring the animation actually runs.

fixes.new_str: import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
fixes.reason: Add useState import required by the mounted guard fix above.
